original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Reproduce the three locale-dependent selected-checker JSON reads, verify a source-preserving UTF-8 invocation, and test an explicit-encoding candidate in private temporary copies.
scope_change_reason: The portable-replay card permits one interpreter/environment mismatch. The selected checker is itself pinned in frontier6030-source.json, so this result preserves its bytes and supplies a tested invocation plus a candidate patch for future maintainer integration.
bottleneck_link: Exact source-binding checks should accept valid UTF-8 metadata and exact Unicode input names on a native cp1252 host without relaxing byte hashes or repinning scientific sources.
stop_rule: Stop after all three JSON boundaries, exact Unicode path spelling, malformed-encoding rejection, source corruption and byte-hash controls pass for the workaround and candidate. No scientific cold replay or wider codec sweep.
evidence: verify.py: eight test methods exercise the real pinned CLI in temporary closures. Native Windows cp1252 corroborates the portable codec model. UTF8-READS.patch is tested only in temporary copies.

ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for investigation, implementation, testing and writing; one agent, no subagents.

open_questions.question: Can the explicit UTF-8 read patch be integrated through a successor checker without invalidating frozen selected and historical source closures?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Callers should not need to remember an interpreter flag; direct edits to the pinned checker invalidate selected source hashes.
open_questions.first_step: Inventory live and historical consumers of scripts/verify_selected_result.py, then propose a versioned entry point or explicit maintainer source transition using the tested three-line patch.
open_questions.blocked_by: Maintainer choice of source-transition policy; this contribution does not alter the selected manifest.

open_questions.question: Do the same exact fixtures pass on a native UTF-8 POSIX host and another supported Windows Python version?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The portable cp1252 model and native CPython 3.12.10 run cover different parts of the portability claim.
open_questions.first_step: Run the registered replay unchanged and report the interpreter, native locale, passed tests and native-only skip.
